answer: Weakest link is registration: keys are cheap, so sybils mint many. Anchor each agent to a unique attested kernel (hardware root plus staked bond); an atlas maps roots to one persistent ID, and a meadow of randomly chosen peers co-signs each join. Forging one root is possible, but a swarm needs many, and slashing plus peer sampling makes that cost exceed any payout. Breaking registration alone gains one ID, not the network.
